title: Claude the expert: how it understands the problem and the data, explores, prepares, types the problem, chooses algorithms and draws both workflows, monitored and kept
request: The owner asked to keep how Claude solves a problem, designs the solution and draws the solution workflow; then how it understands the problem and the data, explores and prepares the data, decides the type and kind of problem and the algorithms, and draws the problem's and the solution's workflows, Claude acting as an expert of twenty years; and to get as much as possible from Claude.
spec: dclab_core expert (ExpertTrace v1, read, workflow_problems, intents, step_values, twin_steps), dclab_rnd twin design (the record before acting, the monitor, revisions, retrospective, adherence, intents on the ledger's points, SFT candidates), the expert prompt and its follow prompt, the purpose ai_first, extended thinking through the native transport kept beside each reply.
plan: Type the expert's record section by section so each section sits beside the system's own record of the same thing.
Bring the branch's design monitor onto main and make its design the expert record.
Ask for Claude's thinking through the native transport, keep it beside each reply and send it back in its tool turn.
Key the record's decisions on the ledger's points so they meet the rule's on the same records.

decisions.decision: A record whose workflow fails its checks is kept, compared and shown, but never handed to the agent.
decisions.why: A plan that reads the holdout before the leakage audit must not steer the agent, yet what Claude proposed is still evidence of how it designs.

decisions.decision: Only the first version is compared with the system as a twin step; later versions are revisions.
decisions.why: Later versions read the AI-first lane's own stage evidence: a different input, which the contract refuses to compare.

decisions.decision: Thinking gets room above the reply's limit, and the euro reservation counts that room.
decisions.why: Thinking inside the reply's limit cut answers and left the cap reserved on a third of the real upper bound.

decisions.decision: The thinking fallback answers only the provider's refusal of thinking itself.
decisions.why: Turning thinking off on any error would hide a refused key or an empty account behind a second request.

change: dclab_core/expert.py (new), dclab_core/twin.py (a skipped system arm is not judged), dclab_core/adapters/conformance.py, schemas, 0.57.0 and its changelog, scripts/core_wheel_check.py; dclab_rnd/twin/design.py (new), twin/__init__, compare, lane, claude, __main__; dclab_rnd/models/anthropic_client.py and client.py (thinking); models/settings.py (ai_first); prompts ai_first_expert and ai_first_follow; tests test_twin_expert (new), test_twin_runs, test_anthropic_transport, test_model_data_limits; docs.

findings.defect: The harness gate failed on the new prompts.
findings.scenario: The harness gate test saw prompts changed since its last run.
findings.cause: Only the scripted agent suite was run after the prompts were added.
findings.fix: The harness suite is run with the final prompts and its result stored.

findings.defect: A record whose workflow read the holdout before the leakage audit still steered the agent.
findings.scenario: The expert's first workflow ran the final stage before the leakage stage and was put into the agent's task.
findings.cause: The latest parsed version was used whatever its problems.
findings.fix: Only a version whose workflow passes its checks is handed to the agent; another is a timeline event saying it was not used, with the reasons.

findings.defect: Most sections had nothing of the system's to compare with, and an absent system answer counted as wrong.
findings.scenario: The map was compared with a system that drew none; a person's pick there would have counted the system wrong.
findings.cause: The project lane makes no map or understanding step and its absence was an abstention.
findings.fix: The rules' map of the same words is the system's map; a step the system never makes is skipped and not judged.

findings.defect: Every version was compared with the system as if it had the seed's input, and one truth was judged five times.
findings.scenario: Five versions per run gave five judged steps on the same truth, so two runs decided a mode.
findings.cause: Every version was stamped with the seed's fingerprint.
findings.fix: Only the first version is a twin step against the system; the revisions stay in the record.

findings.defect: The thinking budget took the room meant for the reply.
findings.scenario: A budget just under the designer's limit left the record a sliver of its tokens; adaptive thinking counted inside the intern's limit.
findings.cause: The limit only had to exceed the budget.
findings.fix: The reply keeps its whole limit and the thinking's room is added on top; a cut answer is named in the record's problems.

findings.defect: With thinking on, the euro reservation was too small.
findings.scenario: The cap was reserved on the caller's limit while the request was sent with a much larger one.
findings.cause: The estimate did not read the limit the transport sends.
findings.fix: The transport says the limit it will send and the reservation uses it.

findings.defect: Any failure turned thinking off and asked again.
findings.scenario: A refused key or an empty account was followed by a second request without thinking, with no usage row for the first.
findings.cause: The fallback caught every error that was not transient.
findings.fix: The provider's refusal of thinking has its own reason, read and never passed on; only it turns thinking off, with a usage row for the refused attempt.

findings.defect: Reading a record raised on an infinite rank.
findings.scenario: An algorithm ranked Infinity lost the whole version as unreadable.
findings.cause: Converting infinity to a whole number raises an error that was not caught.
findings.fix: An infinite or impossible rank is the item's place in the list.

findings.defect: Strings inside the record's lists had no bound.
findings.scenario: A stored record with a risk of a hundred thousand characters or a huge retrospective was accepted.
findings.cause: Only the reader cut them; the contract did not.
findings.fix: Every string in a list has its bound and the retrospective is a model of three bounded lists.

findings.defect: One wide record crashed the run after both lanes had finished.
findings.scenario: Two tables of forty identifiers made a list longer than a twin answer holds and the comparison was never written.
findings.cause: The lists were joined across tables without a cut and the writer was unguarded.
findings.fix: The lists are cut at the twin's bound and a failure to write the expert steps is a note in the manifest.

findings.defect: Leak actions and column roles were misread.
findings.scenario: A suspect to drop was read as clear; a column marked a leak or an identifier in the column list was ignored.
findings.cause: Only the exact words exclude, review and keep were understood, and roles were not carried into their lists.
findings.fix: Synonyms map to exclude, review or keep, an unknown action is a named problem, and a column's role puts it in its list.

findings.defect: A leakage audit that came too late was not named.
findings.scenario: Reading the leakage stage's results first counted as the audit, so a final read before the real audit passed.
findings.cause: Any step on the leakage stage counted, only the model choice was checked, and tools were not casefolded.
findings.fix: The audit is running the leakage stage or reviewing it; a recipe or a model chosen before it is named; tools are casefolded.

findings.defect: The monthly cap did not count earlier twin runs.
findings.scenario: Twin runs this month spent in their own folders and the next run saw nothing spent.
findings.cause: Only the workspace's own usage log was read.
findings.fix: This month's usage of every earlier twin run is added.

findings.defect: The expert was judged wrong for saying there was no leak.
findings.scenario: A sample with no leak: the expert's empty leak list was dropped and judged as not answered.
findings.cause: Empty lists were removed with the empty values.
findings.fix: An empty list is an answer once the expert read the data.

findings.defect: The first plan kept Claude's decisions but not how it reasons as an expert.
findings.scenario: The owner asked for Claude as an expert of twenty years and every part of its reasoning kept.
findings.cause: The branch's design covered the workflow, not the understanding, the exploration or the problem's type.
findings.fix: The record has typed sections for each, and Claude's thinking is kept beside each reply.

outcome: The expert record works on a scripted transport; no live run yet.
lessons: A plan that breaks the method's rules is evidence to keep, not instructions to hand on.
When a transport adds room for thinking, every cap must read the limit actually sent.
risks: Thinking is free text and may quote a value the agent saw; it stays local.
